_doc: Which v1 request scopes (assistant-v1.schema.json turn.scopes) and actions an assistant app gets for the permissions it declares and the person accepted at install (docs/assistant-providers.md §2.10). turn.text and locale always; everything else only through a permission. The server (web/scripts/eap/eap.go eapPermScopes, eapScopeActions) and the validator (cli/src/validate.ts: the permissions an assistant app may declare) read the same table; their tests compare.
